source: Mapped from this.wallet PayPal provider (paypal-provider.js, tools/paypal-server.mjs) plus official PayPal REST paths. Only wired endpoints are usable; planned rows are documented but not called.
notes: Public face is wallet.paypal (PayPal as a provider inside .wallet). Never me.paypal or Paypal .me.
.me does the accounting. PayPal closes an already-expressed amount; it does not compute bills.
wallet.paypal.operators.pay is the high-level call that closes an expressed amount. It uses the wired order endpoints underneath.
Split, sum and divide stay as .me '=' expressions, not PayPal operators.
PayPal hosts: https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com (sandbox, default) and https://api-m.paypal.com (live).
PayPal's Log in with PayPal guide and the Identity v1 API spec name two different userinfo paths. They are mapped separately and are not treated as interchangeable.
A future .GUI PayPal form component should read this file.
A completed capture issues wallet.paypal.receipts[id] and a wallet.paypal.conversation message. Share uses that record.

endpoints.role: Close an already-expressed .me amount: create an order, open PayPal approval, write the capture back to .me.

fields.name: amountCents
fields.notes: Positive integer cents already expressed in .me / .wallet

fields.name: payeeEmail
fields.notes: Pay a member's own PayPal account; otherwise the app's business account receives the funds

endpoints.role: Server-side client-credentials access token. Credentials stay in tools/paypal-server.mjs; the page never sees them.
Exchange a Log in with PayPal authorization code for a user access token. Same HTTP path as oauth.token, different grant. Not wired.
Refresh a Log in with PayPal user access token. Same HTTP path as oauth.token, different grant. Not wired.
Create a checkout order (intent CAPTURE) from an already-expressed amount. custom_id carries group, member and recipient.

fields.name: amountCents
fields.notes: Integer cents; converted to PayPal's decimal string only at this boundary

fields.name: currency
fields.notes: Default USD; JPY, HUF, TWD must be whole units

endpoints.role: Capture an approved order. The capture event is written back to .me (paid.<member>, payments.<captureId>).
Verify a PayPal webhook. On PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, emit the same capture event (once per capture id).
Log in with PayPal user profile, as named in the official integrate guide (go-live userinfo URL). Returned fields depend on consented scopes. Not a generic account-management API. Not wired.
OpenID Connect userinfo from the Identity v1 API spec. This is a different path than /v1/identity/oauth2/userinfo; they are not interchangeable. Returned fields depend on consented scopes. Not wired.
Local server status: { ok, provider, env, configured, webhookConfigured }. Never returns credential values.
Local SSE stream. Event name capture: { orderId, captureId, status, amountCents, currency, groupId, member, to }.
PayPal return_url after approval. Captures the order and closes the popup.

Receipt issued when PayPal captures an order. Built from the capture written back to .me (order id, capture id, amount, parties, time). Not a separate PayPal PDF API; PayPal closes the amount and this receipt is that record.
Messages for this provider session. A completed capture posts a receipt message here so the conversation and the graph show the same issued receipt.
